form.label: Honeypot overview
form.description: Cowrie SSH/Telnet honeypot. Raw logs from ./hp pull; times in UTC. Detections: Detections menu and docs/detections.md.

search.query: index=honeypot sourcetype=cowrie:json | fields _time eventid session src_ip username password input protocol url
search eventid="cowrie.session.connect" | timechart span=1h count by protocol

index=honeypot sourcetype=cowrie:json eventid IN ("cowrie.login.failed", "cowrie.login.success", "cowrie.command.input", "cowrie.session.file_download", "cowrie.session.file_download.failed") | `cowrie_ttp` | where isnotnull(ttp) | mvexpand ttp | bin _time span=1d | stats dc(session) AS sessions by ttp _time | eval day=strftime(_time, "%m-%d") | xyseries ttp day sessions | lookup ttp_rules id AS ttp OUTPUT name tactic | fillnull value=0 | table ttp name tactic *
search eventid="cowrie.session.connect" | iplocation src_ip | geostats count
search eventid="cowrie.session.connect" | iplocation src_ip | stats count AS sessions dc(src_ip) AS sources by Country | sort - sessions | head 15
search eventid IN ("cowrie.login.failed", "cowrie.login.success") | stats count dc(src_ip) AS sources by username password | sort - count | head 15
search eventid="cowrie.command.input" | stats count dc(src_ip) AS sources by input | sort - count | head 15
index=_audit action=alert_fired ss_app=honeypot | stats count AS fired latest(_time) AS last by ss_name | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T") | rename ss_name AS detection | sort detection

search eventid IN ("cowrie.command.input") | stats count AS commands earliest(_time) AS start values(input) AS sample by session src_ip | sort - commands | head 10 | eval start=strftime(start, "%F %T"), sample=mvindex(sample, 0, 4)
